item.title: Murmurly 2.3.0
item.description:
⌘Q keeps Murmurly running

Pressing ⌘Q used to quit, which quietly took the dictation key away with nothing on screen to say so — the next time you held the chord, nothing happened. It now puts Murmurly away into the menu bar and keeps listening. The app menu says so: *Keep Running in the Menu Bar*.

To quit for real, ⌥⌘Q, or *Quit Murmurly* from the menu bar.

Invite a friend has its own page

It sits in the sidebar under Settings, above your account, with your code, your link and how many people have joined. It was a separate window before.

One mark

The sidebar, the setup guide and the sign-in window were drawing a waveform while the app icon is a text caret with sound arriving at it. They all use the icon's mark now, and so does the website.
